Challenges of machine learning: . Data collections: data can be impure or forge wrongly and we have to clean missing values and outlier. . Picking algorithm: choosing algorithm that best fit your case can be hard.
Major applications of data science: - E-commerce: use data science to analyze customer behaviour in order to provide better service. - Medical: detect health issues based on symptom that user has.
We detect outlier in data by using visualization technique like box plot or scatter plot. Data that is furthest away from a group is an outlier.
Data pre-processing is a technique of cleaning data before usage. The process include handling missing values, detect outliers and remove it, data generalization and data normalization.
Normalization is required in K-NN because the smaller the range of the data value, the better for K-NN to detect similarities and differences between classes.
K in K-means algorithm is the number of centroids or group or classes that has similarity.

Regression analysis is a technique of visualizing data that is continuous. When visualize, you will see the regression will minimize the distance between all data points.

Structured data is data that has clear label and definition and its value has the same format. Semi-structured data is data is partially same value format however some of its value can differ. For example: Date 1 is 11/09/2002 while Date 2 is Jan-05-2003. Both data has same meaning but different format.
